titre: Devoir de contrôle n°2 - Anglais (8ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Doing sport is very good for our health. When we play sport, our body becomes stronger and we feel happier. Sport also helps us to make new friends and to learn teamwork. For example, in football or basketball, players must help each other to win. Doctors say that young people should do sport at least three times a week. Unfortunately, today many teenagers spend too much time playing video games or watching television. They sit for hours and they do not move enough. This is bad for their health. We should all be more active and practise a sport we enjoy.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) According to the text, give two benefits of doing sport.   (2 marks)
2) How does sport help us socially?   (2 marks)
3) How often should young people do sport?   (2 marks)
4) What is the bad habit of many teenagers today?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "should / shouldn't": Young people ______ do sport regularly. (advice)   (1,5 marks)
2) Give the comparative of "strong" and "happy".   (2 marks)
3) Complete with a linker (because / but): Sport is good ______ many teenagers do not practise it.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "active" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"Is doing sport important for teenagers?" Write a short paragraph (about 8 lines) giving your opinion with two reasons. Use "should" and linkers.
